sql: select 'experiment' as t, command_id, action, status, actor, actor_role, completed_at from experiment_os_experiment_commands where completed_at between timestamp '2026-09-01 12:00:00+00' and timestamp '2026-09-02 18:00:00+00' union all select 'platform', command_id, action, status, actor, actor_role, completed_at from experiment_os_platform_commands where completed_at between timestamp '2026-09-01 12:00:00+00' and timestamp '2026-09-02 18:00:00+00' union all select 'issue', command_id, action, status, actor, actor_role, completed_at from experiment_os_issue_commands where completed_at between timestamp '2026-09-01 12:00:00+00' and timestamp '2026-09-02 18:00:00+00' order by completed_at
